description: SAP provides enterprise software and cloud platform services for business applications, integration, data, and operations. Its SAP Business Technology Platform and Integration Suite support account administration, API management, and exposing enterprise systems to external applications and AI agents.
summary: sap.com exposes developer surfaces for SAP BTP account management via the `btp` CLI, SAP BTP/XSUAA REST administration APIs, and SAP Integration Suite MCP servers; these use SAP account login or tenant-issued OAuth client credentials.

surfaces.name: SAP Authorization and Trust Management Service APIs
